receipts.title: OpenAI Certificate of Incorporation & Non-Profit Mission Statement
receipts.source: Delaware Division of Corporations / IRS Form 990 / OpenAI Charter
receipts.summary: Establishes OpenAI, Inc. as a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt entity with a fiduciary duty solely to its charter of building safe AGI for humanity, with no duty to generate commercial returns for investors.

receipts.title: OpenAI Nov 2023 Board Crisis & Restructuring Documentation
receipts.source: OpenAI Public Announcements, WilmerHale Independent Review Summary
receipts.summary: Details the dismissal and reinstatement of CEO Sam Altman, subsequent board reconstitution (Bret Taylor, Larry Summers, Paul Nakasone), and the formal resignation of Microsoft's non-voting observer seat.

receipts.title: OpenAI Model Spec & Alignment Policy Documentation
receipts.source: OpenAI Alignment Research / Model Spec v1.0
receipts.summary: Formulates formal guidelines governing model behavior, including handling of copyright, political neutrality, sensitive topics, and operator instructions.

receipts.title: Superalignment Leadership Departures & Public Statements
receipts.source: Statements by Jan Leike, Ilya Sutskever, and Daniel Kokotajlo
receipts.summary: Departing Superalignment co-lead Jan Leike documents that safety culture and processes took a backseat to shiny commercial product velocity, leading to the dissolution of the dedicated 20% compute alignment commitment.

receipts.title: Anthropic Certificate of Incorporation as a Public Benefit Corporation
receipts.source: Delaware Secretary of State / Long-Term Benefit Trust Disclosures
receipts.summary: Specifies Anthropic PBC's public benefit purpose: increasing the likelihood that AI benefits humanity, supervised by the independent Long-Term Benefit Trust holding Class T shares.

receipts.title: Anthropic Responsible Scaling Policy (RSP) v1.0 & v2.0
receipts.source: Anthropic Research Publications
receipts.summary: Establishes AI Safety Levels (ASL-1 to ASL-4) and creates formal organizational commitments to pause model training or deployment if safeguards for CBRN and autonomous capability are not independently certified.

receipts.title: Amazon & Google Multi-Billion Strategic Investment Agreements
receipts.source: Amazon Form 10-K / Alphabet Form 10-K / Anthropic Official Announcements
receipts.summary: Confirms $4B total commitment from Amazon (designating AWS as primary cloud provider) and $2B from Google, granting commercial distribution rights through AWS Bedrock and Vertex AI.

receipts.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
receipts.source: Bai et al., Anthropic Research Paper
receipts.summary: Details post-training method using a written constitution and self-critique (RLAIF) to train models to be helpful, honest, and harmless without human feedback bottlenecks.

receipts.title: Google AI Principles & Responsible AI Framework
receipts.source: Alphabet Inc. Corporate Policy Disclosures
receipts.summary: Sets out seven guiding principles for AI applications at Google, explicitly banning technologies that cause overall harm, weapons, and surveillance violating international law.

receipts.title: US Department of Justice v. Google LLC Antitrust Findings
receipts.source: United States District Court for the District of Columbia (Civil Action No. 20-3010)
receipts.summary: Federal court rules Google maintains an illegal monopoly in general search services and general search text ads, documenting how default distribution contracts protect its core advertising revenue.

receipts.title: Gemini 1.0 Image Generation Historical Depiction Interventions
receipts.source: Google Official Statement by Prabhakar Raghavan
receipts.summary: Google leadership public apology and technical post-mortem acknowledging that tuning aimed at broad representation overcompensated and produced historical inaccuracies, temporarily pausing portrait generation.

receipts.title: Gemini 1.5 System Card & Safety Evaluation Suite
receipts.source: Gemini Team, Google DeepMind Research
receipts.summary: Technical report documenting multimodality, 2M token context window, external red-teaming methodologies, and safety evaluations across biological, cyber, and persuasion vectors.

receipts.title: xAI Articles of Incorporation & Corporate Structure
receipts.source: Nevada Secretary of State Corporate Registry (Entity No. E21235142023-1)
receipts.summary: Establishes xAI Corp. as a Nevada corporation with Elon Musk listed as sole director, cementing absolute corporate and operational governance.

receipts.title: xAI Series B $6B Financing & SEC Form D
receipts.source: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission Form D Filing
receipts.summary: Discloses $6B equity offering with investors including Valor Equity Partners, Vy Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia Capital, and Kingdom Holding, funding the Colossus supercomputer build.

receipts.title: Colossus Supercomputing Cluster 100k H100 Memphis Deployment
receipts.source: xAI Technical Announcement & SemiAnalysis Infrastructure Audit
receipts.summary: Independent engineering audit verifying the installation of 100,000 liquid-cooled Nvidia H100 GPUs in Memphis within 122 days, documenting massive local electrical grid and water requirements.

receipts.title: Grok-1 Open Release Architecture & Model Weights
receipts.source: xAI Technical Announcement & GitHub Repository
receipts.summary: Release of 314B parameter Mixture-of-Experts base model weights under Apache 2.0 license, demonstrating raw pre-training architecture without proprietary RLHF fine-tuning.

receipts.title: Meta Dual-Class Voting Control Disclosures (SEC Schedule 14A)
receipts.source: Meta Platforms, Inc. Definitive Proxy Statement
receipts.summary: Discloses Mark Zuckerberg's beneficial ownership of 61.3% of total voting power through Class B ten-to-one super-voting shares, insulating executive decisions from shareholder activism.

receipts.title: Open Source AI Is the Path Forward — Mark Zuckerberg Open Letter
receipts.source: Meta Platforms Public Letter
receipts.summary: Articulates Meta's strategic rationale for open-sourcing foundational models: commoditizing infrastructure, fostering developer ecosystems, and preventing closed platforms (Apple, Google) from bottlenecking Meta products.

receipts.title: The Llama 3 Community License Agreement
receipts.source: Meta Platforms Legal Documentation
receipts.summary: Imposes commercial restrictions requiring entities with greater than 700 million monthly active users in the preceding calendar month to request a special commercial license directly from Meta.

receipts.title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models Research Report
receipts.source: Dubey et al., Meta AI Research
receipts.summary: Comprehensive 92-page technical report describing pre-training on 15+ trillion tokens, post-training alignment, Llama Guard safety classifiers, and multimodality across the 405B flagship model.

receipts.title: Microsoft Copilot Copyright Commitment Policy
receipts.source: Microsoft Corporate Announcement by Brad Smith
receipts.summary: Legally commits Microsoft to defend enterprise commercial customers and pay adverse judgments if third parties sue for copyright infringement arising from the use of Copilot services, provided guardrails were not circumvented.

receipts.title: Microsoft Form 10-K OpenAI Strategic Partnership Disclosures
receipts.source: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission Microsoft Annual Report
receipts.summary: Discloses Microsoft's multi-billion dollar long-term investment in OpenAI, mutual exclusive cloud partnership, capped profit-sharing mechanisms, and IP licensing scope.

receipts.title: Phi-3 & Phi-4 Technical Reports: Highly Capable Small Models
receipts.source: Abdin et al., Microsoft Research
receipts.summary: Details Microsoft's proprietary small language model development trained on high-quality synthetic 'textbooks' and curated educational web data, reducing compute overhead while remaining under MIT open license.

receipts.title: Microsoft Responsible AI Standard, v2 General Requirements
receipts.source: Microsoft Office of Responsible AI (ORA) Governance Standard
receipts.summary: Mandates impact assessments, governance oversight, data provenance verification, and human oversight gates for all AI systems deployed across Microsoft customer-facing products.

receipts.title: Mistral AI EU AI Act Position Paper & European Lobbying Records
receipts.source: EU Transparency Register / Mistral Policy Briefings
receipts.summary: Documents Mistral AI's direct lobbying alongside the French Ministry of Economy to oppose strict systemic-risk regulations for foundational models in the final negotiations of the European AI Act.

receipts.title: Mistral Large Commercial License & Closed API Launch
receipts.source: Mistral AI Official Announcement
receipts.summary: Announces Mistral Large under a proprietary commercial license hosted exclusively on Azure AI and La Plateforme, formalizing the shift away from an exclusively Apache-2.0 open-weight deployment pipeline.

receipts.title: Mistral Scaleway & European Sovereign Cloud Partnership
receipts.source: Scaleway & Mistral AI Infrastructure Joint Release
receipts.summary: Confirms deployment of Mistral models on Scaleway's Nabuchodonosor supercomputer in Paris, establishing a European sovereign hosting footprint alongside American hyperscalers.

receipts.title: Mixtral of Experts Architectural Evaluation Paper
receipts.source: Jiang et al., Mistral AI Research
receipts.summary: Documents 8x7B sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture matching or outperforming Llama 2 70B on benchmark evaluations with 6x faster inference speeds under Apache 2.0 license.

receipts.title: Command R+ Model Card & Grounded Enterprise RAG Architecture
receipts.source: Cohere Research Technical Report
receipts.summary: Specifies Command R+'s 104B parameter architecture, multi-step tool execution capabilities, automated fine-grained citation spans, and explicit refusal behavior when retrieved context is empty.

receipts.title: Cohere Enterprise Data Security Commitment & Zero Retention Policy
receipts.source: Cohere Trust Center & Enterprise Terms of Service
receipts.summary: Contractual guarantee that customer inputs and completions are never logged, stored, or utilized for foundational model retraining, fulfilling SOC2 Type II compliance.

receipts.title: Cohere & Oracle Cloud Strategic Partnership Agreement
receipts.source: Oracle Corporation Form 10-Q / Joint Press Release
receipts.summary: Establishes Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Supercluster as the core infrastructure provider for Cohere foundational model training and enterprise embedding services.

receipts.title: Cohere Rerank 3 Multilingual Model Evaluation
receipts.source: Cohere Engineering Technical Report
receipts.summary: Documents 100+ language enterprise reranking architecture designed to boost retrieval-augmented generation accuracy in legacy semi-structured JSON and tabular enterprise databases.

receipts.title: DeepSeek-V2 & DeepSeek-Coder-V2 Architecture Reports
receipts.source: DeepSeek-AI Technical Papers
receipts.summary: Documents Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures, compressing KV cache by 93% and dramatically reducing training and inference memory footprint on commodity GPU infrastructure.

receipts.title: Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC) Generative AI Interim Measures
receipts.source: Cyberspace Administration of China Decree No. 12
receipts.summary: Statutory regulation mandating that all public generative AI services operating in China uphold core socialist values and refrain from generating content that subverts state power, damages national unity, or undermines economic order.

receipts.title: DeepSeek-Coder-V2: Breaking the Barrier of Closed-Source Models in Code
receipts.source: Zhu et al., DeepSeek-AI Research Paper
receipts.summary: Demonstrates open-source MoE code model matching GPT-4-Turbo performance across 338 programming languages with 236B total parameters (21B activated) under MIT License.

receipts.title: DeepSeek MIT Open Source License & Weights Repository
receipts.source: DeepSeek-AI GitHub & Hugging Face Repository
receipts.summary: Unrestricted MIT licensing agreement permitting free commercial use, modification, and offline execution without active-user ceilings or royalty payments.

receipts.title: Qwen 2.5 Technical Report & Open-Source Release Suite
receipts.source: Qwen Team, Alibaba Cloud Research
receipts.summary: Presents Qwen 2.5 dense and MoE model suite (0.5B to 72B), reporting open-weight state-of-the-art benchmark results in coding, mathematics, and multilingual support across 29 languages.

receipts.title: Alibaba Cloud DashScope API Governance & CAC Regulatory Filing
receipts.source: Alibaba Cloud Terms of Service & CAC Algorithm Registration List
receipts.summary: Specifies corporate data security covenants and compliance with Chinese internet content governance frameworks for all hosted DashScope model endpoints.

receipts.title: ModelScope Open-Source Ecosystem & Compute Integration Whitepaper
receipts.source: Alibaba Cloud Computing Division
receipts.summary: Documents the deployment of over 3,000 open-weight models on Alibaba's ModelScope hub, integrating domestic cloud GPU leasing with developer workflow tooling across Asia.

receipts.title: Qwen License Agreement & Commercial Use Thresholds
receipts.source: Alibaba Cloud Open Source Documentation
receipts.summary: Apache 2.0 license for models under 32B parameters; custom Qwen license for 72B models granting royalty-free commercial usage for entities under 100 million monthly active users.
